purpose: Gate thresholds that gate values directly but that frozen_benchmark.json does not carry. Before this contract these values were literals inside evaluation/reality_gate/gates.py, so a silent edit (120 -> 12, 0.35 -> 0.9, an answer-method string, an allowed source host) changed what the frozen reality benchmark accepts WITHOUT tripping FROZEN_SHA256. AGENTS.md forbids weakening a frozen benchmark; this contract is the mechanical guard for the thresholds the frozen spec could not reach.
what_did_not_change: No value here differs from the literal it replaced. frozen_benchmark.json is untouched (sha256 ff57f556c3755ab663766618ab7abe763f251e7add70cd8ed964141846d063c8) and the recorded execution record results/evaluation/reality_benchmark/38934722443.json recomputes to a byte-identical verdict with gates.py reading these values instead of literals. This is added coverage, not a re-freeze and not a threshold change.
success_rule: A gate threshold may only change together with a new digest pin for this file and a report entry naming the old and new value. Edit the literal in gates.py instead and the digest test fails.
